newsitem.title: FRANCE: French shares start higher, new record set.
newsitem.headline: French shares start higher, new record set.

text.p: French shares opened higher on Wednesday on the back of gains on Wall Street and a steady dollar, brokers said.
The CAC-40 index set a fresh all-time high shortly after the open and could make a push for the psychologically key 3,000 point level, dealers added.
The government will repay over 90 billion francs in so-called Balladur bonds today and much of this liquidity is expected to be invested in shares.
* CAC-40 index up 17.93, or 0.61 percent, at 2,968.63 at 0803 GMT.
* CAC-40 July futures 2,980 vs 2,957 at Tuesdays close.
